title: Great tour of Barcelona
text: Wonderful walking tour in the Gothic sector and Sangra Familia. Worth the booking.
author: 132lornel

title: Amazing afternoon tour! A+ experience
text:
Matt gave us a great tour!! I really appreciate an afternoon time slot, many flights land (and cruises end) in the morning. This can fill the time nicely if needed. We learned so much in a short time. He was so kind & patient. Great personality & some humor also :-) 
I would not hesitate to take this tour again.
author: eBayQueen98

title: Amazing guide Anatoli, though the tour is a bit pricey
text: While the tour itself felt a bit pricey for what was included, our tour guide Anatoli did an absolutely fantastic job ! He took great care of everyone in the group, and his great sense of humor made the whole trip so much fun and enjoyable. Anatoli truly made the experience worthwhile!
author: dianalM7545CH

title: Excellent choice for a tour
text: Matt provided an excellent safe experience. Our tour included several sites around Barcelona. Matt was full of knowledge about the history of the sites he took us to see, experience and learn about. Matt made our experience personal and customized. Matt communicated with us prior to our pick up and greated us with open arms and smiles. Having the hotel pick up and drop off was an awesome benefit of this tour. title: Excellent tour
text: Didn’t have much time in Barcelona so this 5 hour tour was perfect to get an experience of Barcelona and its culture.  Joris  was an exceptional guide with great knowledge and was able to answer all of our questions. We enjoyed our tour and greatly appreciate Joris’s expertise.

title: Great tour when you are short on time!
text:
Joris was an excellent guide!
We had a great time and learnt a lot about Barcelona, Catalonia and Gaudi!
Ended up being a private tour for the 4 of us! Which was really nice.
